output.reason: [ev-7994b2163342] lists `ces-write-qps-limit` among the Cilium Operator flags that "have been deprecated and their usage will be ignored", and names `ces-rate-limits` as the way to supply a custom configuration. The subject is right. The change type is wrong: "deprecated" means the flag still works, but the evidence says setting it is ignored. That is "removed" (no longer honoured), with --ces-rate-limits as the replacement.

correction.statement: The Cilium Operator flag --ces-write-qps-limit is deprecated and its usage is ignored (no longer honoured); custom CiliumEndpointSlice rate limits are now supplied via --ces-rate-limits (or Helm value ciliumEndpointSlice.rateLimits).
